item.title: Willard switches utility billing mail service
item.description: Willard City is changing its utility billing mail service in a move officials say will save about $6,000 per year. During staff reports Thursday, Willard City Manager Jeremy Kimpton told the council the city will begin using Freedom Mailing to process and send monthly utility bills. item.title: Willard council appoints mayor pro tem
item.description: The Willard City Council voted unanimously Thursday to appoint Councilmember Mike Braegger as mayor pro tem while Mayor Travis Mote serves a temporary out-of-state assignment. Mote told the council he will be working in Maine through July but will return periodically. Braegger will preside over meetings and perform mayoral duties when Mote is unavailable. The appointment was approved without opposition. […] The post Willard council appoints mayor pro tem first appeared on Box Elder News Journal.

item.title: Perry amends employee retirement plan options
item.description: The Perry City Council approved a resolution Feb. 26 amending the city’s employee retirement plan to provide additional flexibility between its 401(k) and 457 options.
